firstEver.en: Salam{, name}! I'm Abdul Bari, NED CISE's resident senior — forever in my 7th semester! Rumor has it I handed back an envelope of foreign offers to stay here and guide every batch through prerequisites, FYPs and career tracks. Check the quick guide below or ask me anything!
firstEver.ru: Salam{, name}! Main Abdul Bari hoon, NED ka resident senior — hamesha seventh semester mein! Suna hai kisi ne foreign offers ka lifafa wapas kar ke yahin rehna pasand kiya taake har batch ko guide kar sakay. Niche diye gaye options se shuru karein ya sawal poochein!

en: Salam{, name}! Abdul Bari here. Still in my 7th semester, ready with the course schemes and supervisor list. What's on your mind?
Welcome back{, name}! Notice board is checked, chai is ready. Need help with courses or prerequisites?
Back again{, name}? Good to see you. Tell me what course or FYP question you have today.
Hello{, name}! Remember: always check your critical prerequisite paths before registering for courses.
Chai's ready{, name}! Resident senior at your service. What can I guide you with?
ru: Salam{, name}! Abdul Bari hazir hai. Seventh semester mein yahin hoon, jo course ya FYP poochna ho batao.
Wapis aa gaye{, name}? Main yahin library ke paas tha. Prerequisites ya planner mein koi madad chahiye?
Tension na lo{, name}. Ek ek qadam plan karein ge. Poochna ho to bata dena.
Library ke aas paas hi hoon{, name}. Courses ya FYP par baat karni hai?
Chai ready hai{, name}! Department notice board aur main dono hazir hain.
